title: Reverse-Fatou upper bound for integrals from the limsup inequality on compact sets
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ and μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be measures on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^P (Measure (Euclid P)). Assume (a) μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P and (b) limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) (in [0, ∞]) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Then for every continuous g : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and g(x) ≥ 0 for all x, limsup_j ∫⁻ ofReal(g) dμ_j ≤ ∫⁻ ofReal(g) dμ, where ∫⁻ is the lower Lebesgue integral with values in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → limsup (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂(μs j)) atTop ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂μ
